header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
None present for the petitioner; nor intimation received.
body: This petition was filed in year 2019 with the prayer that respondents No.1,3,4,6 to 16 be directed not to demolish/ dispossess the petitioner and other residents of Pancha colony till final decision of instant petition. Further perusal of record reflects that there is dispute between the private parties on the government land, therefore, this petition being nonmaintainable is hereby dismissed alongwith listed pending applications leaving the parties to approach proper forum for redressal of their grievance.
